name: skillvault-uninstall
title: SkillVault Uninstall
description: Uninstall global, project, or session skill folders by index, range, comma list, keyword, or skill name after showing matches and confirming deletion.
author: wzlwit

inputs.name: selector
inputs.description: Index, range, comma list, keyword, or skill name to uninstall. Examples: 2, 1,3, 4-6, web-design-guidelines.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Optional scope filter. all includes global and discovered project skill folders; session is explicit only.
